name: sse-query-invalidator-workspace
//: oxlint and oxlint-tsgolint are pinned to exact versions because JS plugins API is in alpha and not semver-stable

scripts.docs:generate: node scripts/generate-api-report.ts && node scripts/generate-api-reference.ts && node scripts/sync-snippets.ts && node scripts/generate-coverage-matrix.ts
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/generate-api-report.ts --check && node scripts/generate-api-reference.ts --check && node scripts/sync-snippets.ts --check && node scripts/generate-coverage-matrix.ts --check && node scripts/check-doc-coverage.ts
scripts.validate: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && node scripts/check-duplicate-tests.ts && pnpm run snippets:typecheck && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run docs:test && pnpm run examples:build
scripts.test:package: pnpm --filter restale-kit run test:coverage && pnpm run build && node scripts/verify-package.ts
scripts.test:ci: pnpm --filter restale-kit run test:coverage && pnpm run build && node scripts/verify-package.ts
